name: RC-B10-0188/2024 – § 1 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran
part_text: 1.Strongly condemns the increasing and systematic repression of women in Iran through laws and regulations that severely restrict their freedoms and rights; notes that the oppression of Iranian women is inherent to Islamic fundamentalism and is a direct result of the application of Sharia law; deplores the fact that authorities detained Ahoo Daryaei, labelling her‘mentally unfit’, and committed her to a psychiatric facility; believes that repression of politically defiant women through psychiatric confinement is an act of torture;
